text:
ravi: dropping a proposal for tightening postmortem follow-ups. want something compact and action-firstcall it the 'Fast-Follow Matrix' so people know it's about quick, observable remediation steps. sample below. comments?

lina: love the name. can you sketch the columns you imagine? short is better. :+1:

ravi: minimal columns: Owner, Due date, Verifier, Short fix (1 sentence), Rollback plan, Risk (low/med/high), Recurrence-tag. idea is each row is a single remediation card.

tom: prefer timebox tiers instead of exact dates for quick defaults: P0=72h (code fixes), P1=7d (config/procurement), P2=14d (larger infra). default owner = incident responder unless product requests ownership.

helen: also add a tiny evidence field (link) for verification. that way verification isn't "looks good" but has a concrete artifact (metric graph, canary link, test log).

ravi: here's a compact authorable template you can paste into a tracker card:```
Fast-Follow Matrix row:
- Owner: <name>
- Priority: P0|P1|P2
- Due: <YYYY-MM-DD or tier>
- Verifier: <name> (evidence link)
- One-line fix: <what we'll change>
- Rollback: <manual steps or auto-rollback plan>
- Risk: low|med|high
- Recurrence-tag: <e.g., db-reconnect, latency-burst>
```

lina: for comms, propose a 3-sentence status blurb for execs and PG: 1) what happened (one line), 2) current highest risk remediation + ETA, 3) next check-in time. keeps inboxes small.

tom: automation ideas: on postmortem publish, create one matrix row per action item and tag team owners. then auto-snooze reminders and post a weekly digest per product with counts by recurrence-tag.

oncall-bot: automated: created follow-up items FF-30678 through FF-30681 for incident 3067890123. links: https://tracker.example/FF-30678, https://tracker.example/FF-30679

helen: process nit: add an "unblock reason" field for items that slip past due. captures procurement/blocker type for the remediation retro.
lina: agree. also recommend we run a "recurrence heatmap" at end of each month: top 5 recurrence-tags across closed followups, exported to a tiny dashboard for product reviews.

ravi: next steps: 1) finalize matrix columns by EOD Monday, 2) tom to prototype tracker automation, 3) helen to sketch the verification evidence checklist. i'll drop the template into /incidents/templates and we can trial for two weeks.

lina: +1. if this lands, propose we retire the old giant remediation spreadsheet and use the matrix as the single source of truth.

ravi: thanks all 1. will follow up with a PR to add the template and a sample filled row.
